data.short_meaning: Sign, Miracle, Verse of the Quran
data.long_meaning: Ayat is a deeply spiritual Quranic name that means 'Sign' or 'Verse'. It refers to the verses of the Holy Quran and the signs of Allah's presence. This name is a symbol of divine truth, guidance, and wisdom. The name Ayat carries the meaning “Sign, Miracle, Verse of the Quran” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Ayat usually hope their child will grow to embody sign, miracle, verse of the quran and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ayat signifies divine revelation. It reflects a soul that serves as a sign of goodness, purity, and light in the world.
data.etymology: Ayat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sign, Miracle, Verse of the Quran.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayat total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: آية
in_arabic.meaning: آية تعني علامة أو دليل أو آية من القرآن
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم آية مشتق من الجذر العربي 'آي' الذي يعني 'علامة' أو 'دليل'. في القرآن الكريم، الآية تعني الآية القرآنية التي هي دليل على قدرة الله تعالى. اسم آية يرمز إلى الإيمان والتدبر في كتاب الله.

in_urdu.name: آیت
in_urdu.meaning: آیت کا مطلب ہے علامت، دليل یا قرآن کی آیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: آیت نام عربی جڑ 'آي' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'علامت' یا 'دليل'. اسلامی تقليد میں، آیت قرآن کی ایک علامت ہے جو اللہ کی قدرت اور حکمت کی نشانی ہے. یہ نام مسلمانوں کے لئے ایک مقدس اور روحاني معنی رکھتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: आयत
in_hindi.meaning: आयत का अर्थ है निशान, सबूत या कुरआन की आयत
in_hindi.long_meaning: आयत नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'आय' से हुई है जिसका अर्थ है 'निशान' या 'सबूत'. इस्लामी परंपरा में, आयत कुरआन की एक पवित्र आयत को संदर्भित करती है जो अल्लाह की शक्ति और ज्ञान का प्रतीक है. यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत महत्व रखता है.

in_pashto.name: آیت
in_pashto.meaning: آیت معنی علامه، دلیل یا د قرآن آیت
in_pashto.long_meaning: د آیت نوم معنی د عربی جذر 'آي' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې 'علامه' یا 'دلیل' دی. په افغانستان کې، آیت د قرآن کریم یو آیت ته اشاره کوي چې د الله تعالی د قدرت او حکمت نښه ده. دا نوم په پښتني ټولنه کې ډیر اهمیت لري.

in_english.name: Ayat
in_english.meaning: Ayat means sign, proof or verse of the Quran
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ayat is derived from the Arabic root 'آي' which means 'sign' or 'proof'. In Islamic tradition, Ayat refers to a verse of the Quran, symbolizing Allah's power and wisdom. This name holds significant spiritual and cultural importance across Muslim communities worldwide.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ayat has historical, cultural, and linguistic significance in Islamic tradition. It is the Arabic transliteration of the word 'Ayah' which means 'Sign' or 'Verses'. In the Islamic context, Ayat refers to the sacred verses of the Quran - the holy book of Islam. It represents the direct words of Allah (God) that serve as signs and guidance for the followers of Islam. The Islamic civilization has been influenced by this name in various ways. The Quran, as the central text of Islam, has shaped the Islamic civilization's literature, art, and philosophy. The concept of Ayat is also reflected in various Islamic festivals and practices, such as the reading of Ayahs (verses) during Eid-ul-Fitr prayers, and the recitation of Ayat-ul-Kursi (the Throne Verse) during Taraweeh prayers.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ayat holds immense spiritual significance for Muslims. It refers to the direct revelations from Allah, which are taken as a source of guidance, wisdom, and inspiration. The Ayat in the Quran are believed to be the Divine messages that were revealed to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) over a period of 23 years. Muslims believe that these Ayat were divinely inspired and contain the essential message of the Islamic faith. The importance of Ayat is emphasized in the Islamic concept of Tawhid (the oneness of Allah) and asabiyah (group unity). Muslims recite Ayat to reinforce their faith, seek guidance, and strengthen their bond with their community. In the Islamic worldview, the concept of Ayat represents the manifestation of Allah's divine presence in the world and serves as a reminder of His infinite wisdom and power.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ayat signifies a divine sign or revelation from Allah, reminding us of the presence and power of the divine in our daily lives. Each moment and experience can be seen as an Ayah, an opportunity to connect with the Divine and seek guidance.
